headline.purpose: Element name at the top of its doc page.

code.purpose: Snippets, install chips, HUD captions, package tags.

shadows.name: ambient-plate
shadows.purpose: Preview plate and mobile drawer only — surfaces that present or float.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible treatment; implemented as outline 2px solid var(--fg), offset 2px.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Hover, border, and press transitions on controls.

components.name: Copy Button
components.description: Every code surface's action; swaps to a check + 'Copied' for 1.6s.
components.html: <button class="ds-copy-btn" type="button"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"/></svg>Copy code</button>
components.css: .ds-copy-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--canvas); color: var(--ink-secondary); font: 500 12px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .12s ease, transform .08s ease; } .ds-copy-btn:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); color: var(--ink); } .ds-copy-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Prop picker — the active option inverts to ink-on-canvas.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--canvas); } .ds-seg-opt { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; background: none; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 13px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-seg-opt.on { background: var(--ink); color: var(--canvas); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Boolean prop control; ink thumb on accent track when on.
components.html: <button class="ds-switch on" type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Toggle"></button>
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--wash); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: background .15s ease; } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink); transition: transform .15s ease; } .ds-switch.on { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-switch.on::after { transform: translateX(16px); background: var(--canvas); }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Generated usage snippet; head row carries filename + copy.
components.html:
usage.jsx
import { ThinkingOrb } from 'thinking-orbs'

<ThinkingOrb state="searching" size={64} />
components.css: .ds-codewrap { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--code-surface); overflow: hidden; } .ds-codewrap-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 8px 8px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-codewrap-title { font: 400 12px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-code { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; overflow-x: auto; font: 400 13px/1.7 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-secondary); }

components.name: Provenance Chip
components.description: The element's origin/facts line — files, license, no-install.
components.html: thinking-orb/ · 16 files · MIT · no npm install
components.css: .ds-install-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--code-surface); font: 400 13px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-secondary); }

components.name: State Cell
components.description: Variant grid cell; selected = ink hairline doubled via inset shadow.
components.css: .ds-state-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 22px 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--canvas); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: border-color .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; } .ds-state-cell:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-state-cell.on { border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink); } .ds-state-cell-label { font: 400 12px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-state-cell.on .ds-state-cell-label { color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Sidebar Link
components.description: Category-rail row; active = wash fill + full ink.
components.css: .ds-side-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: none; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-side-link:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--wash); } .ds-side-link.active { color: var(--ink); background: var(--wash); font-weight: 500; } .ds-side-pkg { margin-left: auto; font: 400 11px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-muted); }

components.name: Preview Plate
components.description: The only shadowed surface — dot-grid canvas + HUD captions.
components.css: .ds-plate { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--canvas); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(9,9,11,0.05), 0 4px 16px -8px rgba(9,9,11,0.1); } .ds-stage { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 340px; padding: 48px 24px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--line-strong) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 20px 20px; background-position: center; } .ds-stage-caption { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 14px; font: 400 11px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-muted); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

narrative.overview: The deliberate canon: the docs-grade component gallery that Storybook and shadcn/ui set as the craft bar, executed without irony. Zinc neutrals, hairline borders, quiet type — every surface decision keeps the showcased element as the loudest thing on the page.
keyCharacteristics: Live preview on a dot-grid canvas — the one textured surface
Controls drive the code snippet; generated source always mirrors preview state
Strict light/dark theming via .dark/.light classes on <html>; hosted elements follow it

rules.name: The Ink Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: Active state is ink-on-canvas inversion, never a hue. Color enters only through showcased components.

rules.name: The Two-Mode Rule
rules.body: Every token exists as a light/dark pair; both classes are maintained on <html> so hosted components resolve theme=auto from an ancestor class.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, cells, and code blocks sit flat behind hairlines. Shadow belongs to the preview plate and floating drawer only.

dos: Do let the showcased element be the only colored or animated thing on the page.
Do keep the generated snippet in sync with the preview controls — omit props at defaults.
Do set both dark and light classes on <html> so hosted components resolve theme=auto correctly.
Do add elements through src/registry.jsx — never by editing the shell.
donts: Don't introduce a brand accent color; the ink inversion is the active state.
Don't put shadows on cards, cells, or code blocks — hairlines carry them.
Don't use the mono face for prose or headings; it is for code, data, and HUD labels only.
Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings.
